entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.

Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I can certainly look into that return for you. I have your account pulled up. So I can best assist you, could you tell me, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it works fine. It's just... I changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and if I'm being honest, I just don't use it like I thought I would. I feel bad about it, and I really could use the money back.

I understand completely, sometimes a product just doesn't fit into our routine the way we expect. I see you've had it for a few weeks. Typically, for a change of preference like this, our primary solution is the official VeloFit resale marketplace. You can often get most of your money back from another member of the community.

A resale site? Oh, I don't know... that sounds like a lot of hassle. I was really just hoping for a simple return. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I was just hoping you could help me out. It would be a huge relief.
Of course, I understand. Please hold on for just one moment while I review the exact policy details for your purchase. It's important we get this right for you.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've just checked our knowledge base, and you're in luck. It looks like your purchase is still well within the 90-day return period. My apologies for mentioning the other option first. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank goodness! That is such wonderful news. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Isaac.

You're very welcome. I'm sending the prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help!
Happy to assist. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
